summary: Expose write-worker admission backlog and abandoned request starts

replay.detail: No claim, projection or replay changes.

schema.detail: Queue timestamps and requester liveness are process-local; storage schema and digests are unchanged.

rules.detail: Writer admission, dependent permit sharing and detached mutation completion are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: The existing OTel pipeline exports st.write_workers.queue.depth, st.write_workers.queue.oldest_age (seconds), st.write_workers.queue.wait (seconds, bounded normalized route origin), and st.write_workers.abandoned (outcome=ran). Observable gauges include admission and blocking-pool waits until callback start; explicit admission leaves the queue at grant. Dropped request waiters are observed without skipping work.

downtime.detail: No additional downtime beyond the normal binary restart.

manual.detail: Existing OTel exporter configuration applies. No additional setup is required.

recovery.detail: Binary swap-back requires no data migration.
